correctness.rationale: The established 2n dihedral extensions have precisely stated multiplicities. Cyclic-run absence is equivalent to an empty h-fold partial power. The transfer trace counts each cyclic domain pattern once; rotation orders and reflection orbit types exhaust cases. Duplicated nilpotent empty, singleton and even-antipodal rank-two maps contribute exactly the subtractions in the formula. For n>=4, h>=2, all expressions are defined. h=1 is handled separately. Independent exact enumeration of all partial maps for n<=6 and dihedral restrictions through n=10 corroborates every coefficient. The infinite proof is combinatorial, not experimental.

originality.rationale: The original 2022 paper proves the restriction-to-dihedral-group lemma and total-size formula, not rank-by-power nilpotent counts. The 2023 studies of the same monoid and submonoids focus on sizes/ranks/Green relations/presentations. The new joint nilpotent filtration, exact even-antipodal duplicate correction and n*phi(n) maximum-index count are not supplied by those statements. Published-index and primary-literature alias/implication checks found no stronger covering result; unindexed equivalence remains a risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed general enumerator of nilpotent restrictions of permutation groups could subsume this special dihedral case even without using the words partial isometry.
Third follow-up paper was checked for scope and nilpotency terms but was not read line by line; the two closest papers were inspected more materially.
Only self-review has been performed; external independent audit remains pending.

value.rationale: The theorem simultaneously counts all ranks and exact nilpotency indices of a natural infinite family of finite inverse transformation monoids. It introduces a parity-sensitive correction absent from ordinary cardinality formulas and derives closed total-nilpotent and maximal-index counts n*phi(n). These are intrinsic semigroup invariants that refine prior cardinality, Green-relation and generator-rank work; their motivation does not rely on speculative downstream significance.
